simetri.render.render_svg.filters

SVG filter element builders (<filter> and filter primitives).

Dataclass wrappers for SVG filter primitives with to_element() / to_string() helpers for emitting markup. Each element supports an extra dict for additional presentation attributes.

   1"""SVG filter element builders (``<filter>`` and filter primitives).
   2
   3Dataclass wrappers for SVG filter primitives with ``to_element()`` /
   4``to_string()`` helpers for emitting markup. Each element supports an
   5``extra`` dict for additional presentation attributes.
   6"""
   7
   8from __future__ import annotations
   9
  10import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
  11from collections.abc import Sequence
  12from dataclasses import dataclass, field
  13from typing import Any, ClassVar
  14
  15from ...base.all_enums import ColorMatrix, FilterType
  16from ...config.settings import runtime_defaults
  17
  18Number = int | float
  19NumOrStr = Number | str
  20MaybeSeq = None | str | Number | Sequence[NumOrStr]
  21
  22SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
  23XLINK_NS = "http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
  24
  25
  26def _fmt_value(v: Any) -> str:
  27    """Convert Python values to SVG attribute strings."""
  28    if v is None:
  29        raise ValueError("internal: _fmt_value called with None")
  30
  31    if isinstance(v, bool):
  32        return "true" if v else "false"
  33    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
  34        return str(v)
  35    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
  36        return " ".join(_fmt_value(x) for x in v)
  37    return str(v)
  38
  39
  40def _set_attrib(el: ET.Element, name: str, value: Any) -> None:
  41    if value is None:
  42        return
  43    el.set(name, _fmt_value(value))
  44
  45
  46@dataclass
  47class SVGElement:
  48    """
  49    Base element with common SVG-ish attributes.
  50    Examples:
  51        >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVGElement
  52        >>> SVGElement(id='n').id
  53        'n'
  54    """
  55
  56    id: str | None = None
  57    class_: str | None = None  # maps to "class"
  58    style: str | None = None
  59    extra: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
  60
  61    def _apply_common(self, el: ET.Element) -> None:
  62        _set_attrib(el, "id", self.id)
  63        _set_attrib(el, "class", self.class_)
  64        _set_attrib(el, "style", self.style)
  65        for k, v in self.extra.items():
  66            _set_attrib(el, k, v)
  67

  69# ----------------------------
  70# Filter container (<filter>)
  71# ----------------------------
  72@dataclass
  73class SVG_Filter(SVGElement):
  74    """SVG ``<filter>`` element containing filter primitives.
  75
  76    Examples:
  77        >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVG_Filter, feGaussianBlur
  78        >>> filt = SVG_Filter(id='blur')
  79        >>> filt.add(feGaussianBlur(stdDeviation=1)).id
  80        'blur'
  81
  82    Attributes:
  83        x: Filter region x.
  84        y: Filter region y.
  85        width: Filter region width.
  86        height: Filter region height.
  87        filterUnits: ``userSpaceOnUse`` or ``objectBoundingBox``.
  88        primitiveUnits: Coordinate system for primitives.
  89        color_interpolation_filters: ``sRGB`` or ``linearRGB``.
  90        filterRes: Optional filter resolution.
  91        href: SVG2 href reference.
  92        xlink_href: Legacy xlink:href reference.
  93        primitives: Child ``FilterPrimitive`` instances.
  94    """
  95
  96    x: NumOrStr | None = None
  97    y: NumOrStr | None = None
  98    width: NumOrStr | None = None
  99    height: NumOrStr | None = None
 100
 101    filterUnits: str | None = None  # userSpaceOnUse | objectBoundingBox
 102    primitiveUnits: str | None = None  # userSpaceOnUse | objectBoundingBox
 103    color_interpolation_filters: str | None = None  # "sRGB" | "linearRGB"
 104    filterRes: str | tuple[int, int] | None = None
 105
 106    href: str | None = None  # SVG2
 107    xlink_href: str | None = None  # SVG1.1 legacy
 108
 109    primitives: list["FilterPrimitive"] = field(default_factory=list)
 110
 111    def add(self, *prims: "FilterPrimitive") -> "SVG_Filter":
 112        """Append filter primitives and return ``self`` for chaining.
 113
 114        Args:
 115            *prims: One or more ``FilterPrimitive`` instances.
 116
 117        Returns:
 118            SVG_Filter: This filter, for fluent calls.
 119
 120        Examples:
 121            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVG_Filter, feGaussianBlur
 122            >>> SVG_Filter().add(feGaussianBlur()).primitives[0].to_element().tag
 123            'feGaussianBlur'
 124        """
 125        self.primitives.extend(prims)
 126        return self
 127
 128    def to_element(self) -> ET.Element:
 129        """Build an ``xml.etree.ElementTree.Element`` for this filter.
 130
 131        Returns:
 132            ET.Element: ``<filter>`` element with child primitives.
 133
 134        Examples:
 135            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVG_Filter
 136            >>> SVG_Filter().to_element().tag
 137            'filter'
 138        """
 139        # Note: ElementTree namespaces are easiest if we emit plain tags here and
 140        # include xmlns at the top-level string creation (see to_string()).
 141        el = ET.Element("filter")
 142
 143        self._apply_common(el)
 144        _set_attrib(el, "x", self.x)
 145        _set_attrib(el, "y", self.y)
 146        _set_attrib(el, "width", self.width)
 147        _set_attrib(el, "height", self.height)
 148        _set_attrib(el, "filterUnits", self.filterUnits)
 149        _set_attrib(el, "primitiveUnits", self.primitiveUnits)
 150        _set_attrib(
 151            el, "color-interpolation-filters", self.color_interpolation_filters
 152        )
 153
 154        if isinstance(self.filterRes, tuple):
 155            _set_attrib(
 156                el, "filterRes", f"{self.filterRes[0]} {self.filterRes[1]}"
 157            )
 158        else:
 159            _set_attrib(el, "filterRes", self.filterRes)
 160
 161        _set_attrib(el, "href", self.href)
 162        if self.xlink_href:
 163            el.set(f"{{{XLINK_NS}}}href", self.xlink_href)
 164
 165        for p in self.primitives:
 166            el.append(p.to_element())
 167
 168        return el
 169
 170    def to_string(
 171        self,
 172        pretty: bool = True,
 173        include_defs: bool = True,
 174        include_xmlns: bool = True,
 175    ) -> str:
 176        """Serialize this filter to an SVG markup string.
 177
 178        Args:
 179            pretty: If True, indent the XML for readability.
 180            include_defs: If True, wrap the filter in a ``<defs>`` element.
 181            include_xmlns: If True, set the SVG xmlns on the root element.
 182
 183        Returns:
 184            str: SVG markup for the filter (optionally wrapped in ``<defs>``).
 185
 186        Examples:
 187            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVG_Filter
 188            >>> '<filter' in SVG_Filter(id='f').to_string(include_defs=False)
 189            True
 190        """
 191        # Register xlink prefix if we might use it
 192        ET.register_namespace("xlink", XLINK_NS)
 193
 194        root = self.to_element()
 195
 196        if include_xmlns:
 197            # Ensure SVG namespace is present on the top element (works fine when embedding in <svg>)
 198            root.set("xmlns", SVG_NS)
 199
 200        if include_defs:
 201            defs = ET.Element("defs")
 202            if include_xmlns:
 203                defs.set("xmlns", SVG_NS)
 204                defs.set("xmlns:xlink", XLINK_NS)
 205            defs.append(root)
 206            root = defs
 207
 208        if pretty:
 209            _indent_xml(root)
 210
 211        return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
 212
 213
 214def _indent_xml(elem: ET.Element, level: int = 0) -> None:
 215    """In-place pretty-printer for ElementTree.
 216
 217    Args:
 218        elem: ElementTree node to format (mutated).
 219        level: Current indentation depth.
 220    """
 221    i = "\n" + level * "  "
 222    if len(elem):
 223        if not elem.text or not elem.text.strip():
 224            elem.text = i + "  "
 225        for child in elem:
 226            _indent_xml(child, level + 1)
 227        if not elem.tail or not elem.tail.strip():
 228            elem.tail = i
 229    else:
 230        if level and (not elem.tail or not elem.tail.strip()):
 231            elem.tail = i
 232

 237@dataclass
 238class FilterPrimitive(SVGElement):
 239    """
 240    Base class for primitives with common primitive-region attributes.
 241    Examples:
 242        >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import feBlend
 243        >>> feBlend().__class__.__mro__[1].__name__
 244        'FilterPrimitive'
 245    """
 246
 247    # Common filter primitive attributes
 248    x: NumOrStr | None = None
 249    y: NumOrStr | None = None
 250    width: NumOrStr | None = None
 251    height: NumOrStr | None = None
 252
 253    in_: str | None = None  # maps to "in"
 254    result: str | None = None
 255    primitive_type: ClassVar[FilterType] = None
 256
 257    @property
 258    def type(self) -> FilterType:
 259        """Return the SVG filter primitive type enum.
 260
 261        Returns:
 262            FilterType: Primitive type for this filter element.
 263
 264        Examples:
 265            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import feGaussianBlur
 266            >>> feGaussianBlur().type.name
 267            'GAUSSIAN_BLUR'
 268        """
 269        return self.primitive_type
 270
 271    def _apply_primitive_common(self, el: ET.Element) -> None:
 272        self._apply_common(el)
 273        _set_attrib(el, "x", self.x)
 274        _set_attrib(el, "y", self.y)
 275        _set_attrib(el, "width", self.width)
 276        _set_attrib(el, "height", self.height)
 277        _set_attrib(el, "in", self.in_)
 278        _set_attrib(el, "result", self.result)
 279

 332    values: MaybeSeq | None = None
 333
 334    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 335        if self.matrix_type is None:
 336            self.matrix_type = runtime_defaults["filter_color_matrix_type"]
 337
 338        if self.values is None:
 339            if self.matrix_type == ColorMatrix.SATURATE:
 340                self.values = runtime_defaults["filter_color_matrix_saturate"]
 341            elif self.matrix_type == ColorMatrix.HUE_ROTATE:
 342                self.values = runtime_defaults["filter_color_matrix_hue_rotate"]
 343            else:
 344                self.values = runtime_defaults["filter_color_matrix_values"]
 345
 346    def to_element(self) -> ET.Element:
 347        """Build an ElementTree element for this SVG filter node.
 348
 349        Returns:
 350            ET.Element: XML element ready for serialization.
 351
 352        Examples:
 353            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import feColorMatrix
 354            >>> feColorMatrix().to_element().tag
 355            'feColorMatrix'
 356        """
 357        el = ET.Element("feColorMatrix")
 358        self._apply_primitive_common(el)
 359        _set_attrib(el, "type", self.matrix_type)
 360        _set_attrib(el, "values", self.values)
 361        return el

1005@dataclass
1006class feMerge(FilterPrimitive):
1007    """
1008    SVG ``<feMerge>`` filter primitive.
1009    Examples:
1010        >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import feMerge
1011        >>> feMerge().to_element().tag
1012        'feMerge'
1013    """
1014
1015    primitive_type: ClassVar[FilterType] = FilterType.MERGE
1016    nodes: list[feMergeNode] = field(default_factory=list)
1017
1018    def add_node(self, in_: str) -> "feMerge":
1019        """Append an ``feMergeNode`` and return ``self`` for chaining.
1020
1021        Args:
1022            in_: Input image name for the merge node.
1023
1024        Returns:
1025            feMerge: This merge primitive.
1026
1027        Examples:
1028            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import feMerge, feMergeNode
1029            >>> feMerge().add_node(feMergeNode()).to_element().tag
1030            'feMerge'
1031        """
1032        self.nodes.append(feMergeNode(in_=in_))
1033        return self
1034
1035    def to_element(self) -> ET.Element:
1036        """Build an ElementTree element for this SVG filter node.
1037
1038        Returns:
1039            ET.Element: XML element ready for serialization.
1040
1041        Examples:
1042            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import feMerge
1043            >>> feMerge().to_element().tag
1044            'feMerge'
1045        """
1046        el = ET.Element("feMerge")
1047        self._apply_primitive_common(el)
1048        for n in self.nodes:
1049            el.append(n.to_element())
1050        return el

112    def add(self, *prims: "FilterPrimitive") -> "SVG_Filter":
113        """Append filter primitives and return ``self`` for chaining.

130        """Build an ``xml.etree.ElementTree.Element`` for this filter.

132        Returns:

135        Examples:
136            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVG_Filter
137            >>> SVG_Filter().to_element().tag

141        # include xmlns at the top-level string creation (see to_string()).

162        _set_attrib(el, "href", self.href)

171    def to_string(
172        self,
173        pretty: bool = True,
174        include_defs: bool = True,
175        include_xmlns: bool = True,
176    ) -> str:
177        """Serialize this filter to an SVG markup string.
178
179        Args:
180            pretty: If True, indent the XML for readability.
181            include_defs: If True, wrap the filter in a ``<defs>`` element.
182            include_xmlns: If True, set the SVG xmlns on the root element.
183
184        Returns:
185            str: SVG markup for the filter (optionally wrapped in ``<defs>``).
186
187        Examples:
188            >>> from simetri.render.render_svg.filters import SVG_Filter
189            >>> '<filter' in SVG_Filter(id='f').to_string(include_defs=False)
190            True
191        """
192        # Register xlink prefix if we might use it
193        ET.register_namespace("xlink", XLINK_NS)
194
195        root = self.to_element()
196
197        if include_xmlns:
198            # Ensure SVG namespace is present on the top element (works fine when embedding in <svg>)
199            root.set("xmlns", SVG_NS)
200
201        if include_defs:
202            defs = ET.Element("defs")
203            if include_xmlns:
204                defs.set("xmlns", SVG_NS)
205                defs.set("xmlns:xlink", XLINK_NS)
206            defs.append(root)
207            root = defs
208
209        if pretty:
210            _indent_xml(root)
211
212        return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
